import numpy as np
from scipy import ndimage as ndi
im=np.array(Image.open('/app/target.png').convert('L'))
# ink threshold
x=im<80
# Zhang-Suen thinning
s=x.copy(); changed=True
while changed:
 changed=False

  p=np.pad(s,1)
  P2=p[:-2,1:-1];P3=p[:-2,2:];P4=p[1:-1,2:];P5=p[2:,2:];P6=p[2:,1:-1];P7=p[2:,:-2];P8=p[1:-1,:-2];P9=p[:-2,:-2]
  nb=P2.astype(int)+P3+P4+P5+P6+P7+P8+P9
  seq=[P2,P3,P4,P5,P6,P7,P8,P9,P2]
  trans=sum((~a & b) for a,b in zip(seq[:-1],seq[1:]))
  if step==0: cond=(P2*P4*P6==0)&(P4*P6*P8==0)
  else: cond=(P2*P4*P8==0)&(P2*P6*P8==0)
  rem=s&(nb>=2)&(nb<=6)&(trans==1)&cond
  if rem.any(): s[rem]=False;changed=True
lab,n=ndi.label(x)
print('components',[(i+1,int((lab==i+1).sum()),ndi.find_objects(lab)[i]) for i in range(n)])

pad=np.pad(s,1)
count=np.zeros_like(s,dtype=int)
for dy in (-1,0,1):
 for dx in (-1,0,1):

for k in range(1,n+1):

# overlay yellow skeleton, endpoints red, grid blue
rgb=np.array(Image.open('/app/target.png').convert('RGB'))
rgb[s]=[0,220,50]
y,xep=np.where(s&(count==1));rgb[y,xep]=[255,0,0]

+        p = self.command_pose.copy()
+        distance = math.hypot(x - p[0], y - p[1])
+        n = max(1, int(math.ceil(distance / 0.08)))
+        travel = []
+        for i in range(1, n + 1):
+            t = i / n
+            row = self.command_pose.copy()
+            row[:3] = [p[0] + t * (x - p[0]), p[1] + t * (y - p[1]), z_clear]

target=np.array(im)

best=None
for dy in range(-22,23):
 for dx in range(-22,23):
  shifted=np.roll(np.roll(M,dy,axis=0),dx,axis=1)
  inter=np.count_nonzero(shifted&T); union=np.count_nonzero(shifted|T)
  iou=inter/union
  if best is None or iou>best[0]:best=(iou,dx,dy,inter,union)
print('target area',int(T.sum()),'actual area',int(M.sum()),'best',best)
_,dx,dy,_,_=best
S=np.roll(np.roll(M,dy,axis=0),dx,axis=1)
# boundary F within 1mm (~4.5 px)
dtT=ndi.distance_transform_edt(~T); dtS=ndi.distance_transform_edt(~S)
prec=np.mean(dtT[S]<=4.5); rec=np.mean(dtS[T]<=4.5); F=2*prec*rec/(prec+rec)
